items.headline: Jets score on first 5 drives and edge Chargers 27-24 to snap 5-game skid
items.description: — Geno Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns, including two to Sterling Shepard, and the New York Jets scored on their first five drives to beat the Los Angeles Chargers 27-24 on Sunday and end a five-game skid.
